tell: All units are not recalled; only Motorola DCT2000 digital cable set-top boxes distributed from March 2002 through June 2002 are included.

title: CPSC, Briggs & Stratton Announce Recall of Engines Used on Fun Kart Type Go-Karts
hazard: Fuel from the engine can spill out, if the fun-kart overturns, posing serious fire and burn hazards to consumers.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the fun-karts immediately and contact a local Briggs & Stratton dealer for a free engine repair.
tell: All 1352XX model series are included. For FunPower 1362XX, only engines built on or before June 22, 1995 with a 2 inch tall plastic fuel cap are recalled. Model and date codes are stamped on the engine.

title: National Sporting Goods Announce Recall of Speed Skates
hazard: The wheel and axle assemble may break off during skating, resulting in injury to the skater.
remedy: Consumers should stop using the skates immediately and return them to the nearest JCPenney catalog desk for a free replacement.
tell: You can tell the recalled skates by model numbers 809-0205 or 809-0256, coming in black or white with the word Bullet written on the side.
